culprit_citations.quoted_text: Portfolio Investments ... Par/Shares | Amortized Cost | Market Value

findings.detail: The source schedule is USD-denominated, but cost_currency was stored as a custom non-USD unit token instead of normalized USD.

rationale: FX03 flags cost_currency values stored as UNIT_STANDARD_USD_TJGR_KXHI0CIJAMHOSYKXA. The raw portfolio schedule labels the amount columns as Amortized Cost and Market Value and shows dollar signs in the amount cells, e.g. table 15 row 6 has USD dollar markers for par/shares, amortized cost, and market value. The source therefore supports USD denomination; the defect is the extraction/normalization of the currency unit, not the filing data.
